name: Ozone Generator
summary: Chemical-free disinfection and oxidation using ozone (O₃).
blocks: Ozone Generator – Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises

An Ozone Generator from Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises is an advanced, eco-friendly disinfection and oxidation system designed for water treatment, air purification, and industrial sanitation applications. It utilizes cutting-edge technology to generate ozone (O₃), one of the most powerful natural oxidizing agents, ensuring superior purification without the use of harmful chemicals.

An ozone generator is a device that converts oxygen (O₂) into ozone (O₃) using high-voltage electrical discharge or UV technology. The generated ozone is then injected into water or air to eliminate contaminants, micro organisms, and odors effectively.
The system operates on the principle of Corona Discharge Technology:
Oxygen/air is passed through an ozone chamber
Free oxygen atoms recombine to form ozone (O₃)
Ozone is injected into water via diffusers or venturi systems
It reacts with pollutants and microbes, oxidizing and destroying them
Ozone naturally decomposes back into oxygen, leaving no harmful residue.
High ozone output with stable performance
Ozone generators are widely used across industries:
Mineral water & packaged drinking water plants
Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP) & Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
Removal of bacteria, viruses, and organic contaminants
Ozone is highly effective in destroying microorganisms and oxidizing pollutants, making it ideal for drinking water and wastewater treatment systems.

Chemical-Free: Eliminates need for chlorine and other chemicals
Eco-Friendly: Converts back to oxygen after use

name: Jockey Pumps
summary: Keep fire mains pressurised so the main pump starts only when needed.
blocks: A jockey pump is a small, low-capacity, high-pressure pump used in a fire protection system to maintain the water pressure in the piping (fire mains). It is an essential component designed to prevent the main fire pump from starting unnecessarily.

In a fire sprinkler or hydrant system, pressure can drop slightly over time due to small leaks or changes in temperature. The jockey pump senses this minor drop and turns on to restore the required pressure. This ensures that the main fire pump only activates during an actual fire or a major pressure drop.
Capacity (Flow): They have a very low flow rate, typically only 1% to 3% of the main fire pump's capacity.
Pressure: The pressure rating is usually slightly higher than that of the main fire pump to ensure the system stays pressurized above the main pump's start point.
Pump Type: Most commonly Multistage Vertical Centrifugal Pumps, as they are efficient at maintaining high pressure with low water volume.
The Pump: Small electric motor-driven pump.
Controller: An automated panel that monitors system pressure via a pressure switch.
Check Valve: Prevents backflow from the main system into the pump.
